Market today: Tech and chip names are seeing positive momentum today, fueled by strong AI spending news. Anthropic's massive revenue run rate and Nvidia's huge investment in OpenAI data centers are driving confidence in the sector.

Your holdings: SOXL is a major concern, flagged SELL and down over 40%. As a leveraged ETF on margin, this drawdown is amplified. SPAL, another new leveraged ETF, is also down 34%. SMH is down 6.65%.

Watch: Closely monitor SOXL's default stop at 200 and SPAL's stop at 21.38. Leveraged ETFs are highly volatile and decay, making stop discipline crucial.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing risk on your leveraged, underperforming positions while the broader tech/chip narrative remains strong.
plays: SOXL: Respect the default stop at 200. Given the -40.46% loss and leveraged nature, consider trimming or exiting if it continues to fall.
SPAL: This new leveraged position is down 34.04%. Watch its stop at 21.38 closely; leveraged ETFs move fast.
NVDA: Consider a new buy on NVDA, which has an ACCUMULATE scanner setup (entry 224.78-224.56, stop 224.22), supported by the OpenAI data center news.
